title: Students protest administrative detention of Palestinian activist in Jerusalem

tea.why: A Palestinian student at Hebrew University was arrested and placed under administrative detention without trial.
tea.want: Protesters demand the immediate release of the student activist and an end to administrative detention.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Around 200 protesters gathered outside the Jerusalem District Court during a detention hearing.

summary: Jewish and Arab students, university representatives, and activists gathered outside the Jerusalem District Court and on university campuses to demand the release of a 26-year-old Palestinian student activist from east Jerusalem. The student was arrested at university dormitories under administrative detention procedures allowing detention without charge or trial. The protest action was organized by Standing Together along with other groups. Demonstrators accused authorities of detaining the student for political activity. Police stated that the arrest was made under a court warrant over suspected ties to a terrorist act in a joint investigation with Shin Bet.
demands: Release of the detained student activist
End to administrative detention without trial
response: Police stated the student was arrested under a court warrant for suspected connection to a terrorist act in an investigation with Shin Bet.

crowd.text: about 200 demonstrators outside the court according to The Jerusalem Post

updates.text: Students demonstrate across university campuses against the administrative detention of a Palestinian student activist.
About 200 protesters gather outside Jerusalem District Court as a hearing takes place on the student's detention order.
